name: Related Investigation Data 1
definition: Provides information on data related to the investigation that is being sent seperately to the message.

InvestigationIdentification.name: Investigation Identification
InvestigationIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify data or documentation sent separately from the request or reponse, such as a copy of a passport.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Provides information on the location and/or delivery of the related investigation data or documentation.
